raw_description:
A long horizontal ink flourish — central small compass-rose motif
flanked by thin hairline rules that fade to nothing at either end.
Chapter-break feel from a 19th-century atlas.
formatted_prompt: Editorial field-journal ink illustration on aged vellum parchment, centered horizontal composition with generous negative space above and below. A delicate compass-rose rosette at center — rendered in fine nib-pen linework with warm ochre (#C9A96B) and slate ink detailing — flanked symmetrically by thin hairline rules that taper and dissolve into the vellum ground at both ends. The ruled lines carry faint watercolor bleed at junctions, subtle foxing dots scattered along the margins. Muted warm vellum (#E7E3D5) background, slate-gray (#B8B5A6) ink linework, restrained and contemplative. Chapter-break ornament weight — precise, archival, civilizationally scaled. No fills beyond hairline wash, no glow, no digital gloss. Hand-drawn atlas plate feel throughout.
